# Accordion

Organize related content into independently expandable sections.

## Examples

### Single

Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input.

<ComponentExample component="accordion" scenario="single" title="Single" description="Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input." :index="0" />

### Multiple

Select several values independently without collapsing the existing selection.

<ComponentExample component="accordion" scenario="multiple" title="Multiple" description="Select several values independently without collapsing the existing selection." :index="1" />

### Required

Require one value to remain selected or one section to remain expanded.

<ComponentExample component="accordion" scenario="required" title="Required" description="Require one value to remain selected or one section to remain expanded." :index="2" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the focused section. |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Move focus between section triggers. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move focus to the first or last section trigger. |

## Accessibility

Section triggers expose expanded state and control their content regions.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/accordion/) for the host accessibility contract.
